project_overview.name: Fotuber
project_overview.description: Smart appointment and staff management system for a photography/video studio. Features a public marketing interface and a protected admin panel.

design_philosophy.public_site: Premium, deep, and creative. Archetype 5: Luxury. Emphasizes visual storytelling with a dark, moody aesthetic. Contrast and large typography are key.
design_philosophy.admin_dashboard: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast. Bright, functional, and data-dense. Distinct from the public site to signal a professional work environment.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant adapted for luxury photography.

headings.usage: Hero titles, section headers, elegant large text.

body.usage: Body text, small labels, and all Admin Dashboard text.

public_site.hero: Full height (min-h-screen) with background image, dark overlay (bg-black/40). Text left-aligned or centered with asymmetrical decorative elements.
public_site.services_grid: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris). Mix of tall, wide, and square cards. Generous gaps (gap-8).
public_site.booking_flow: Step-by-step layout. Clear progress indicators. Centered narrow container for form inputs to maintain focus.
public_site.calendar: Interactive grid. Booked slots MUST be clearly disabled (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed, line-through or greyed out). Open slots highlight on hover.

admin_dashboard.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid (Mode B). gap-6. Cards for revenue, pending bookings, today's schedule.
admin_dashboard.table: Dense data table for staff and bookings. Sticky headers, hover rows.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or subtle radius (rounded-lg). High contrast. Hover triggers subtle scale and brightness change.
buttons.whatsapp: Fixed floating button bottom right. Bright green (#25D366).

surfaces.admin_cards: Solid white, flat, 1px border (border-slate-200), no shadow default, subtle shadow on hover.

calendar_slot.available: border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-black transition-colors

motion.hover_states: Buttons scale up (1.02) and change brightness. Images in Bento grid scale up slowly on hover (group-hover).
motion.calendar: Staggered fade-in for available time slots.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for elegance in public site. Use stroke-width 2 for clarity in Admin.

hero.description: Moody DSLR camera setup in studio

specific_requirements.contact_info: Phone: 0(501) 000 25 23. Must be prominent in the 'Urgent Service' message and floating buttons.
specific_requirements.urgent_message: Next to blocked calendar slots, display: 'Bu saatte acil bir hizmete mi ihtiyacınız var?' with WhatsApp and Phone CTA.
specific_requirements.deposit_workflow: Client booking status defaults to 'Beklemede' (Pending). Displays custom message about deposit (kapora). Admin can change status to 'Onaylandı' (Approved) which blocks the slot on public calendar.
specific_requirements.admin_features: Revenue charts (use Recharts), deposit tracking, staff management list.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in Turkish as requested.
Implement Shadcn UI for the Admin dashboard heavily (Tables, Cards, Dialogs, Select, Calendar).
For the public site, rely on custom HTML/Tailwind for the layout to achieve the 'Luxury' archetype, but you can use Shadcn for forms/modals.
Create a toggle or distinct routing for Public Site (Dark) and Admin (Light). e.g., `/` is dark, `/admin` is light.
Use 'framer-motion' for scroll animations on the public site.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors or subtle textures.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
DO NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
DO NOT use a fully transparent background for headers/navs if content scrolls under it. Use backdrop-blur with a semi-transparent color.
